I will apply some DAP and urea from the cooperative on this rented plot, though not as much as the extension agent recommends, because I need it to yield enough to cover the rent and still feed my family. I will also spread manure from my cows here since I cannot afford to buy more chemical fertilizer, and I will use seed I saved from last season's harvest because improved seed is too expensive and hard to find for the crops I grow on this small piece of land. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate because this plot depends on the meher rains and those inputs cost money I do not have, so my family and I will do all the work ourselves over the season.
